comment: Acceptance criteria added by the Engine Pack Manager correction pass (ADR-0013), outside the 150 of the specification.

criteria.subject: Standalone engines on a clean Windows
criteria.criterion: On Windows 10/11 without Python, Java, Ghidra or Ghidriff: start ACET, FAST available, Engines button shows the missing pack, Install Engine Pack, consent, download, verification, installation, real doctor, READY, a STANDARD analysis really runs; no manual installation of Python/Java/Ghidra.

criteria.subject: Offline installation
criteria.criterion: Without network, Install Engine Pack explains the network is unavailable; Install from file with a valid package then works (same validations as a download).

criteria.subject: Corrupted package
criteria.criterion: A package with one modified byte fails with INTEGRITY_FAILURE and nothing is activated.

criteria.subject: Crash during installation
criteria.criterion: Killing ACET during extraction, then restarting: previous pack intact, staging detected and cleaned, nothing considered READY by mistake.

criteria.subject: Engines UI
criteria.criterion: Engines button always reachable; status not conveyed by colour only; progress, cancel, error, retry; no UI freeze.

criteria.subject: Profile gating
criteria.criterion: With FAST only: FAST READY, STANDARD/DEEP UNAVAILABLE; after an Engine Pack, only health-checked engines make a profile READY (a folder on disk never does).
